paper_title: Up-To Techniques for Behavioural Metrics via Fibrations
classifications: Theory of computation → Formal languages and automata theory
Theory of computation → Logic and verification
statement: We leave for future work several open problems. What is a universal property for the canonical Wasserstein lifting? Secondly, can the Wasserstein liftings presented here be captured in the framework of [2] or [24]? We also leave for future work the development of up-to techniques for other quantales than 2 and [0, 1]. We are particularly interested in weighted automata [16] over quantales and in conditional transition systems, a variant of featured transition systems.
context: In [5] we provided a generic construction for the Wasserstein lifting of a functor to the category of pseudo-metric spaces, rather than on arbitrary quantale-valued relations. The realisation that this construction is an instance as a change-of-base situation between V-Rel and V-Pred allows us to exploit the theory in [9] for up-to techniques and, as a side result, provides simpler (and cleaner) conditions for the restriction V-Cat (Theorem 21). We leave for future work several open problems. What is a universal property for the canonical Wasserstein lifting? Secondly, can the Wasserstein liftings presented here be captured in the framework of [2] or [24]? We also leave for future work the development of up-to techniques for other quantales than 2 and [0, 1]. We are particularly interested in weighted automata [16] over quantales and in conditional transition systems, a variant of featured transition systems.
